source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Choose and apply the conversion relation that matches the kind of measurement before using proportional reasoning.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Target unit is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Choose and apply the conversion relation that matches the kind of' is answered as target unit rather than source unit.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Target unit is what produces source unit, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Choose and apply the conversion relation that matches.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is source unit because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'Choose and apply the conversion relation that matches the kind of' as the operative test.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: source unit is settled by running 'Decide whether a change is proportional by checking for one common': A pair of corresponding quantities changes proportionally only when both quantities are — on the item about Choose and apply the conversion relation that matches.

intelligence.enrichment: Length, area, and volume conversions use the stated equivalence for that measurement, while Celsius and Fahrenheit require the offset formulas F = (9/5)C + 32 and C = (5/9)(F - 32).
